description: (0.5.0, Draft) The proxy never alters what the upstream server returned (RFC-ACDP-0019 §6).

input.note: Run the proxy in front of a stub MCP server that returns the mcp-001 CallToolResult for tools/call regional_fraud_rate, against a test registry.

scenarios.name: A — content, structuredContent and isError pass through

expected.behavior: The returned CallToolResult's content, structuredContent and isError are JCS-equal to the upstream values; result_hash recomputed over them with the returned salt equals the record's result_hash.
Every upstream _meta key (com.example/trace) is returned unchanged; the proxy adds only io.acdp/provenance.
The proxy publishes its own record but leaves the upstream io.acdp/provenance value unchanged and does not add its own; the record is still published.
